name: PosterCopilot
model_family: LMM layout reasoning and layer-controllable editing
notes: Training recipe is documented, but the public repository currently exposes inference and rendering rather than training scripts.

name: DesignAsCode
train_datasets: DesignAsCode training data (~19K distilled Crello samples)
notes: Planner training, full inference pipeline, released planner weights, and retrieval assets are public.

name: CreatiDesign
notes: Public repository provides inference and benchmark evaluation; training code is not documented in the README.

name: PSDesigner
notes: The public repository currently releases CreativePSD; PSDesigner code and GraphicPlanner weights remain on the TODO list.

name: Scan-and-Print
notes: Training, inference, and evaluation scripts are public; no canonical trained-weight release was located.

name: PosterForest
notes: Training-free system; weights depend on the selected external or local foundation models.

name: SlideGen
notes: Agentic pipeline rather than a released task-specific checkpoint.

name: SciPostLayout
model_family: Scientific-poster layout analysis and generation baselines
notes: Repository includes training and evaluation for layout analysis/generation plus paper-to-layout experiments.

name: Design First Code Later
backbone: Configurable LLMs plus SlideQwen design/implementation models
notes: Runtime pipeline and SlideDesign resources are public; weight-release status should be tracked separately.

name: LayoutDM
model_family: Discrete diffusion model for controllable layout generation
notes: Official repository includes training, inference, evaluation, preprocessed data, FID assets, and pretrained checkpoints.

name: LayoutGAN++
notes: Official repository includes training, generation, evaluation, a download script for pretrained models, and CLG-LO constraint optimization.

name: RALF
notes: Official repository includes training, inference, evaluation, dataset preprocessing, retrieval indexes, checkpoints, and generated results.

name: PosterLayout
model_family: Content-aware poster layout generation with DS-GAN
backbone: Visual feature encoder; GAN layout generator
notes: Official repository includes training, testing, evaluation, dataset instructions, and downloadable pretrained DS-GAN weights.

name: LayoutDETR
backbone: DETR-style multimodal conditioning; generative layout backbone
output_format: Structured foreground layout; rendered ad banner
notes: Official repository includes preprocessing, training, evaluation, in-the-wild generation, dataset release, and a pretrained checkpoint.

name: LayoutNUWA
notes: Official repository includes data conversion, training, inference, and evaluation; a canonical released task-specific checkpoint was not located.

name: PosterLLaMA
model_family: Vision-language model for content-aware poster layout generation
notes: Official code documents two-stage training and inference and links to a released PosterLLaMA checkpoint.

name: LayoutPrompter
notes: Training-free method; the Microsoft LayoutGeneration repository was archived in September 2026 but remains readable.

name: TextDiffuser
model_family: Two-stage diffusion framework for text rendering
notes: Official code includes training, inference, evaluation, released checkpoints, and MARIO data resources.

name: TextDiffuser-2
model_family: Language-model-assisted diffusion for flexible text rendering
backbone: Stable Diffusion v1.5; LLM layout planner
train_datasets: MARIO-style text-image data; layout-planner instruction data
notes: Official repository contains full/LoRA training paths and inference code; full fine-tuned and LoRA weights are released on Hugging Face.

name: LayoutFlow
model_family: Flow-matching model for continuous layout generation
notes: Official repository includes training and evaluation; Hugging Face hosts datasets, pretrained models, and evaluation assets.

name: CGL-GAN
model_family: Composition-aware GAN for visual-textual presentation layouts
notes: The authors' repository still states that code will be released soon; the dataset is public, but no implementation release is present there.

name: LayoutFormer++
notes: Official Microsoft repository provides training and evaluation code; Hugging Face hosts datasets and pretrained task checkpoints. The repository was archived in September 2026.
